title: Faster modals and lighter pages
summary: Modals open faster, search boxes stay responsive while you type, and pages download far less image data.

changes.text: Scan review, material picker, scanner settings and material details now load only when you open them, so pages load less code up front.

Material icons in lists, grids and the picker are about 10x smaller (around 4 KB instead of 40 KB each) and load only when scrolled into view. Opening the material picker now downloads under 200 KB of icons instead of over 2 MB.
Typing in the review and material picker search boxes stays responsive, and editing one scanned slot no longer redraws the whole list.
The animated background pauses while a modal is open, so the blurred backdrop costs less GPU time.
Scanner settings no longer contact the server on every page load, only when you open them.
